<![CDATA[import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

// The gallery and the downloadable template serve the same self-contained document.
export function GET() {
  const html = readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "downloads", "stillwater.html"), "utf8");
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
}
]]>

<![CDATA[<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="description" content="Stillwater is a fictional collection of private coastal sanctuaries, made for a slower way of being.">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#1d2a28">
  <title>Stillwater | Another pace of living</title>
  <style>
/* Hallmark · theme: custom · idea: the coast sets the pace · vibe: quiet, coastal, architectural, unhurried · hero: photographic stage · nav: edge-aligned · footer: quiet mast · posture: dark/light editorial · v2.0.0 */
/* critique: The image must feel like a place, and every control must be honest about this fictional collection. */
/* user-directed exceptions: the reference calls for an uppercase editorial voice, an eyebrow, a tight three-line title, a vertical collection label, and a scroll cue. */
/* waive 24b: exact optical spacing follows the supplied reference; 39b: large gallery rows are easier to use; 59 and 79: the closing image and hero reserve breathing room for photography. */
/* hero-review: in-thread, mobile crop fixed; finish-review: in-thread, contrast and focus fixed; reference-directed lint findings remain. */
@font-face{font-family:Stillwater Serif;src:url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2');font-style:normal;font-weight:400 500;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:Stillwater Sans;src:url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2');font-style:normal;font-weight:400 500;font-display:swap}
:root{--font-display:Stillwater Serif,Georgia,serif;--font-body:Stillwater Sans,Arial,sans-serif;--oyster:#eee9e0;--paper:#f4f0e8;--stone:#ded7ca;--ink:#34332e;--forest:#253733;--forest-deep:#182521;--sage:#aebdaf;--sand:#c8af98;--white:#faf8f1;--muted:#5c625a;--rule:rgba(52,51,46,.65);--light-rule:rgba(250,248,241,.65);--overlay:rgba(9,16,15,.74);--overlay-soft:rgba(9,16,15,.08);--overlay-mid:rgba(9,16,15,.39);--error:#9d4438;--focus:#d2a16f;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);--gutter:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);--container:1320px;--gap:clamp(24px,4vw,64px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;overflow-x:clip}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-color:var(--muted) var(--paper)}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
::selection{background:var(--sage);color:var(--forest-deep)}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
button,a,select,input,textarea{caret-color:var(--focus)}
button{cursor:pointer}
button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:4px}
h1,h2,h3,p,figure{margin:0}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;overflow-wrap:break-word;min-width:0}
p{text-wrap:pretty}
.container{width:min(calc(100% - var(--gutter)*2),var(--container));margin-inline:auto}
.skip-link{position:fixed;z-index:100;top:10px;left:10px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-160%)}
.skip-link:focus{transform:translateY(0)}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:720px;height:100svh;max-height:1200px;isolation:isolate;background:var(--forest-deep);color:var(--white)}
.hero-image,.hero-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.hero-image{object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 50%;z-index:-2}
.hero-shade{z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--overlay) 0%,var(--overlay-mid) 37%,var(--overlay-soft) 74%),linear-gradient(0deg,var(--overlay-mid),transparent 30%)}
.hero-shell{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.site-header{height:92px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:24px}
.wordmark{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(28px,2.35vw,35px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.035em;white-space:nowrap}
.header-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(22px,2.5vw,38px)}
.header-nav a,.header-reserve,.mobile-menu a{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.header-nav a,.text-link{position:relative}
.header-nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.header-nav a::after,.text-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-6px;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 450ms var(--ease)}
.header-nav a:hover::after,.header-nav a:focus-visible::after,.text-link:hover::after,.text-link:focus-visible::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.header-reserve{justify-self:end;border:1px solid var(--light-rule);padding:12px 20px;transition:background-color 350ms var(--ease),color 350ms var(--ease),border-color 350ms var(--ease)}
.header-reserve:hover{background:var(--white);color:var(--forest-deep);border-color:var(--white)}
.menu-toggle{display:none;justify-self:end;border:1px solid var(--light-rule);background:transparent;color:inherit;min-width:48px;min-height:44px;padding:11px}
.no-script-nav{display:none;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase}
.menu-toggle span{display:block;width:22px;height:1px;margin:5px auto;background:currentColor;transition:transform 300ms var(--ease)}
.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:first-child{transform:translateY(3px) rotate(45deg)}
.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:last-child{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(-45deg)}
.mobile-menu{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:78px;left:var(--gutter);right:var(--gutter);padding:16px 22px;background:var(--forest-deep);border:1px solid var(--light-rule)}
.mobile-menu[hidden]{display:none}
.mobile-menu a{display:block;padding:13px 0}
.hero-copy{padding-top:clamp(38px,7vh,90px);max-width:650px}
.hero-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(78px,8.6vw,124px);line-height:.76;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero h1 span{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.hero h1 .line-mask{overflow:clip;padding:.08em 0 .07em;margin:-.08em 0 -.07em}
.hero h1 .line-mask span{display:block}
.hero-description{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(19px,1.5vw,22px);line-height:1.25;max-width:420px;margin-top:27px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:24px}
.text-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.035em;text-transform:uppercase;min-height:44px}
.text-link .arrow{font-size:16px;line-height:1;transition:transform 350ms var(--ease)}
.text-link:hover .arrow{transform:translate(3px,-3px)}
.collection-mark{position:absolute;right:20px;top:50%;writing-mode:vertical-rl;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.hero-bottom{margin-top:auto;padding-bottom:clamp(30px,5vh,50px);display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}
.booking-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr .75fr auto;align-items:stretch;width:min(100%,685px);border:1px solid var(--light-rule);background:var(--overlay-mid)}
.booking-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-width:0;padding:7px 12px;border-right:1px solid var(--light-rule)}
.booking-field label{font-size:11px;line-height:1.2;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--oyster)}
.booking-field input,.booking-field select{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;padding:3px 0 0;background:transparent;color:var(--white);font-size:12px;outline-offset:2px;color-scheme:dark}
.booking-field select option{background:var(--forest-deep);color:var(--white)}
.booking-field input::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator{opacity:.9;cursor:pointer}
.booking-submit{align-self:center;min-height:44px;margin:7px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--white);border-radius:50px;background:transparent;color:var(--white);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color 350ms var(--ease),color 350ms var(--ease)}
.booking-submit:hover{background:var(--white);color:var(--forest-deep)}
.booking-message{font-size:12px;position:absolute;bottom:14px;color:var(--white)}
.scroll-cue{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:49px;border:1px solid var(--light-rule);border-radius:20px;font-size:10px}
.section{padding:clamp(90px,10vw,150px) 0}
.section-label{font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:400;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em}
.section-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(54px,6.1vw,92px);line-height:.91;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-wrap:balance}
.section-title > .section-label{display:block;margin-bottom:32px;line-height:1.5}
.section-copy{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;max-width:380px}
.inline-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:44px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;transition:opacity 300ms var(--ease)}
.inline-link:hover{opacity:.65}
.intro{background:var(--oyster)}
.intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:var(--gap);align-items:start}
.intro-heading{max-width:710px;margin-top:0}
.intro-right{padding-top:clamp(8px,6vw,85px)}
.intro-right .section-copy{margin-bottom:28px}
.intro-image{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1.35;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 58%;margin-top:44px}
.caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding-top:12px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)}
.retreats{background:var(--paper)}
.section-heading-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px;margin-bottom:55px}
.section-heading-row .section-title{max-width:710px;margin-top:0}
.section-heading-row .section-copy{padding-bottom:8px}
.retreat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:var(--gap)}
.retreat-card{min-width:0}
.image-frame{overflow:clip;background:var(--stone)}
.retreat-card .image-frame{aspect-ratio:4/5}
.image-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 900ms var(--ease)}
.retreat-card:hover .image-frame img{transform:scale(1.025)}
.retreat-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:20px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)}
.retreat-card h3{font-size:37px;line-height:1;margin:10px 0 9px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.retreat-card p{font-size:14px;max-width:310px;min-height:3.1em}
.retreat-link{min-height:44px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding:0 0 5px;margin-top:12px;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;font-size:11px}
.retreat-link:hover{opacity:.6}
.feature{background:var(--forest);color:var(--oyster)}
.feature-intro{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:40px;margin-bottom:48px}
.feature-intro .section-title{max-width:680px;margin-top:0}
.feature-intro .section-copy{max-width:290px}
.feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(0,.55fr);gap:var(--gap);align-items:stretch}
.feature-image{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:590px;max-height:760px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 58%}
.feature-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid var(--light-rule)}
.feature-tabs{display:grid}
.feature-tab{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;text-align:left;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--light-rule);padding:25px 0;background:transparent;color:var(--oyster);opacity:.62;transition:opacity 300ms var(--ease)}
.feature-tab[aria-pressed="true"],.feature-tab:hover{opacity:1}
.feature-tab span:first-child{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:31px;line-height:1}
.feature-tab span:last-child{font-size:11px}
.feature-caption{padding-top:50px}
.feature-caption h3{font-size:36px;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:16px}
.feature-caption p{max-width:300px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}
.experiences{background:var(--stone)}
.experience-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:var(--gap);align-items:center}
.experience-heading{margin:0 0 45px;max-width:540px}
.experience-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.experience-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:35px 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:baseline;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);padding:20px 0}
.experience-list span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.experience-list h3{font-size:29px;line-height:1}
.experience-list p{grid-column:2;font-size:13px;margin-top:-13px;max-width:360px}
.experience-image{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover}
.journal{background:var(--paper)}
.journal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:var(--gap);align-items:center}
.journal-image{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.12;object-fit:cover}
.journal-content{padding:35px clamp(0px,3vw,45px)}
.journal-content .section-title{margin:0 0 27px}
.journal-content .section-copy{margin-bottom:35px}
.journal-controls{display:flex;gap:24px;margin-top:60px}
.journal-control{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding:8px 0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;transition:color 300ms var(--ease),border-color 300ms var(--ease)}
.journal-control[aria-pressed="true"],.journal-control:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.statement{background:var(--oyster);text-align:center;padding:clamp(110px,13vw,190px) 0}
.statement p{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(49px,7vw,104px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-wrap:balance}
.statement small{display:block;margin-top:35px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.inquiry{background:var(--paper)}
.inquiry-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:clamp(60px,10vw,150px)}
.inquiry-heading{margin:0 0 25px}
.inquiry-note{max-width:340px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}
.inquiry-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px 28px}
.form-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.form-field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.form-field label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em}
.form-field input,.form-field select,.form-field textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:48px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:0;padding:9px 0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.form-field textarea{min-height:86px;resize:vertical}
.form-field input[aria-invalid="true"],.form-field select[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--error)}
.primary-button{justify-self:start;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;min-height:50px;padding:0 22px;border:1px solid var(--forest);background:var(--forest);color:var(--white);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;transition:background-color 350ms var(--ease),color 350ms var(--ease),transform 200ms var(--ease)}
.primary-button:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--forest)}
.primary-button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.form-status{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:1.5em;font-size:13px;color:var(--forest)}
.preview{grid-column:1/-1;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:14px}
.preview[hidden]{display:none}
.preview strong{display:block;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:8px}
.preview p+p{margin-top:8px}
.final-cta{min-height:620px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;isolation:isolate;color:var(--white);background:var(--forest-deep)}
.final-cta img,.final-cta::after{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.final-cta img{object-fit:cover;z-index:-2}
.final-cta::after{content:"";z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--overlay),var(--overlay-soft))}
.final-cta .section-title{max-width:700px;font-size:clamp(65px,8vw,116px);text-transform:uppercase}
.final-cta .inline-link{margin-top:35px}
.footer{background:var(--forest-deep);color:var(--oyster);padding:70px 0 30px}
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:45px;align-items:start}
.footer .wordmark{font-size:clamp(42px,6vw,80px)}
.footer-line{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;margin-top:20px}
.footer-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,auto);gap:13px 45px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em}
.footer-nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.footer-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.footer-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:85px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--light-rule);font-size:11px;color:var(--sage)}
dialog{width:min(900px,calc(100% - 40px));max-height:min(760px,calc(100% - 40px));padding:0;border:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
dialog::backdrop{background:var(--overlay)}
.dialog-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
.dialog-image{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:500px;object-fit:cover}
.dialog-content{position:relative;padding:70px 40px 45px}
.dialog-close{position:absolute;right:20px;top:18px;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-size:25px;line-height:1}
.dialog-content h2{font-size:clamp(48px,5vw,70px);line-height:.92;margin:22px 0}
.dialog-content p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:18px}
.dialog-content .primary-button{margin-top:20px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
  .hero-image{animation:hero-settle 2.4s var(--ease) both}
  .hero h1 .line-mask span{animation:line-arrive 1.1s var(--ease) both}
  .hero h1 .line-mask:nth-child(2) span{animation-delay:100ms}
  .hero h1 .line-mask:nth-child(3) span{animation-delay:200ms}
  @keyframes hero-settle{from{transform:scale(1.045)}to{transform:scale(1)}}
  @keyframes line-arrive{from{transform:translateY(105%)}to{transform:translateY(0)}}
  .section.is-in .intro-image,.section.is-in .feature-image,.section.is-in .experience-image,.section.is-in .journal-image{animation:photo-settle 1.25s var(--ease) both}
  @keyframes photo-settle{from{transform:scale(1.015);opacity:.85}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
}
@media (max-width:1000px){
  .site-header{grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto}
  .header-nav{display:none}
  .has-js .menu-toggle,.no-script-nav{display:block}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(76px,10vw,105px)}
  .feature-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.65fr)}
  .feature-image{min-height:500px}
}
@media (max-width:700px){
  :root{--gutter:24px;--gap:24px}
  .hero{min-height:800px;max-height:none;height:100svh}
  .hero-image{object-position:right center}
  .hero-shade{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--overlay),var(--overlay-mid) 70%,var(--overlay-soft)),linear-gradient(0deg,var(--overlay),transparent 60%)}
  .site-header{height:78px}
  .header-reserve{display:none}
  .hero-copy{padding-top:clamp(28px,5vh,52px)}
  .hero-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.19em;margin-bottom:18px}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(59px,14.4vw,88px);line-height:.8}
  .hero-description{font-size:19px;max-width:300px;margin-top:23px}
  .hero-actions{gap:0 8px;margin-top:18px}
  .text-link{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0;gap:5px}
  .collection-mark,.scroll-cue{display:none}
  .hero-bottom{padding-bottom:25px}
  .booking-strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));width:100%}
  .booking-field{min-height:49px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--light-rule)}
  .booking-field:nth-child(even){border-right:0}
  .booking-field:nth-child(3),.booking-field:nth-child(4){border-bottom:0}
  .booking-submit{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:stretch;border-radius:0;margin:0;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--light-rule);min-height:43px}
  .booking-message{bottom:3px;font-size:10px}
  .section{padding:85px 0}
  .section-title{font-size:clamp(48px,12vw,70px)}
  .intro-grid,.feature-grid,.experience-grid,.journal-grid,.inquiry-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .intro-heading{margin-top:0}
  .intro-right{padding-top:0}
  .intro-image{margin-top:30px}
  .section-heading-row,.feature-intro{display:block;margin-bottom:35px}
  .section-heading-row .section-copy,.feature-intro .section-copy{margin-top:24px}
  .retreat-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:48px}
  .retreat-card .image-frame{aspect-ratio:4/4.3}
  .retreat-card p{min-height:0}
  .feature-image{min-height:0;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/4.5}
  .feature-caption{padding-top:35px}
  .experience-grid{gap:45px}
  .experience-image{aspect-ratio:4/4.5}
  .journal-grid{gap:35px}
  .journal-content{padding:0}
  .journal-controls{margin-top:35px}
  .inquiry-grid{gap:45px}
  .final-cta{min-height:540px}
  .final-cta .section-title{font-size:clamp(58px,13vw,80px)}
  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .footer-nav{justify-content:start}
  .footer-bottom{margin-top:55px}
  .dialog-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .dialog-image{min-height:0;height:240px}
  .dialog-content{padding:35px 25px}
}
@media (max-width:360px){
  :root{--gutter:18px}
  .hero{min-height:760px}
  .hero h1{font-size:14vw}
  .hero-copy{padding-top:25px}
  .hero-description{font-size:18px}
  .inquiry-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .form-field.full,.form-status,.preview{grid-column:auto}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
  </style>
  <script>document.documentElement.classList.add('has-js');</script>
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>
  <main id="main">
    <section class="hero" id="top" aria-label="Stillwater coastal sanctuaries">
      <picture><source media="(max-width: 700px)" srcset="data:image/webp;base64,"><img class="hero-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1672" height="941" alt="A limestone villa and infinity pool overlooking the sea at dusk" fetchpriority="high"></picture>
      <div class="hero-shade" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="container hero-shell">
        <header class="site-header">
          <a class="wordmark" href="#top" aria-label="Stillwater home">STILLWATER</a>
          <nav class="header-nav" aria-label="Main navigation">
            <a href="#retreats">Retreats</a><a href="#experiences">Experiences</a><a href="#philosophy">Philosophy</a><a href="#journal">Journal</a>
          </nav>
          <a class="header-reserve" href="#inquiry">Reserve your stay</a>
          <button class="menu-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="mobile-menu" aria-label="Open menu" disabled><span></span><span></span></button>
          <noscript><a class="no-script-nav" href="#retreats">Explore retreats</a></noscript>
          <nav class="mobile-menu" id="mobile-menu" aria-label="Mobile navigation" hidden>
            <a href="#retreats">Retreats</a><a href="#experiences">Experiences</a><a href="#philosophy">Philosophy</a><a href="#journal">Journal</a><a href="#inquiry">Reserve your stay</a>
          </nav>
        </header>
        <div class="hero-copy">
          <p class="hero-kicker">Private coastal sanctuaries</p>
          <h1><span class="line-mask"><span>Another</span></span><span class="line-mask"><span>pace of</span></span><span class="line-mask"><span>living.</span></span></h1>
          <p class="hero-description">Places that invite you to disconnect, slow down, and rediscover the extraordinary in stillness.</p>
          <div class="hero-actions"><a class="text-link" href="#retreats">Explore our retreats <span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><a class="text-link" href="#philosophy">The Stillwater philosophy</a></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-bottom">
          <form class="booking-strip" id="quick-booking" novalidate>
            <div class="booking-field"><label for="quick-destination">Destination</label><select id="quick-destination" name="destination"><option value="">Any sanctuary</option><option>Casa Mare</option><option>Casa Oliva</option><option>Casa Sera</option></select></div>
            <div class="booking-field"><label for="quick-arrival">Arrival</label><input id="quick-arrival" name="arrival" type="date"></div>
            <div class="booking-field"><label for="quick-departure">Departure</label><input id="quick-departure" name="departure" type="date"></div>
            <div class="booking-field"><label for="quick-guests">Guests</label><select id="quick-guests" name="guests"><option value="2">2 guests</option><option value="1">1 guest</option><option value="3">3 guests</option><option value="4">4 guests</option><option value="5">5 guests</option><option value="6">6 guests</option></select></div>
            <button class="booking-submit" type="submit" disabled>Find your stay</button>
          </form>
          <a class="scroll-cue" href="#philosophy" aria-label="Scroll to the philosophy">↓</a>
          <p class="booking-message" id="booking-message" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span class="collection-mark" aria-hidden="true">01 / Coastal collection</span>
    </section>

    <section class="section intro" id="philosophy">
      <div class="container intro-grid">
        <div><h2 class="section-title intro-heading"><span class="section-label">The Stillwater philosophy</span>Space to feel everything by doing less.</h2></div>
        <div class="intro-right"><p class="section-copy">Some places ask nothing of you. Here, the days are shaped by the light, the sea, and the simple pleasure of being exactly where you are.</p><a class="inline-link" href="#experiences">Discover the Stillwater way <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><img class="intro-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" loading="lazy" alt="A sunlit limestone lounge looking out to the coast"><div class="caption"><span>Room to breathe</span><span>At the water’s edge</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section retreats" id="retreats">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="section-heading-row"><div><h2 class="section-title"><span class="section-label">Our sanctuaries</span>A place to be elsewhere.</h2></div><p class="section-copy">Three imagined coastal homes, each offering its own way to slow down.</p></div>
        <div class="retreat-grid">
          <article class="retreat-card"><div class="image-frame"><img id="image-terrace" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" loading="lazy" alt="A stone terrace and pool above a quiet bay"></div><div class="retreat-meta"><span>Cliffside sanctuary</span><span>2 to 4 guests</span></div><h3>Casa Mare</h3><p>Stone, sea, and long afternoons at the edge of the coast.</p><button class="retreat-link" type="button" data-retreat="mare" disabled>Explore retreat <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></article>
          <article class="retreat-card"><div class="image-frame"><img id="image-lounge" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" loading="lazy" alt="A light-filled villa lounge framed by olive trees"></div><div class="retreat-meta"><span>Olive grove house</span><span>2 to 6 guests</span></div><h3>Casa Oliva</h3><p>A considered home surrounded by olive trees and open sky.</p><button class="retreat-link" type="button" data-retreat="oliva" disabled>Explore retreat <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></article>
          <article class="retreat-card"><div class="image-frame"><img id="image-bedroom" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" loading="lazy" alt="A tranquil bedroom opening towards the sea"></div><div class="retreat-meta"><span>Secluded hideaway</span><span>2 to 4 guests</span></div><h3>Casa Sera</h3><p>A quiet refuge for waking slowly and staying a little longer.</p><button class="retreat-link" type="button" data-retreat="sera" disabled>Explore retreat <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section feature" id="the-house">
      <div class="container"><div class="feature-intro"><div><h2 class="section-title"><span class="section-label">A closer look</span>A house in conversation with the coast.</h2></div><p class="section-copy">A sense of place, expressed in the details that matter.</p></div>
        <div class="feature-grid"><img class="feature-image" id="feature-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" loading="lazy" alt="A private terrace overlooking the water"><div class="feature-side"><div class="feature-tabs" aria-label="Explore the house"><button class="feature-tab" type="button" data-feature="privacy" aria-pressed="true" disabled><span>Privacy</span><span>01</span></button><button class="feature-tab" type="button" data-feature="architecture" aria-pressed="false" disabled><span>Architecture</span><span>02</span></button><button class="feature-tab" type="button" data-feature="nature" aria-pressed="false" disabled><span>Nature</span><span>03</span></button></div><div class="feature-caption" aria-live="polite"><h3 id="feature-title">Entirely your own.</h3><p id="feature-copy">A secluded setting gives you the freedom to follow the day at your own pace.</p></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section experiences" id="experiences">
      <div class="container experience-grid"><div><h2 class="section-title experience-heading"><span class="section-label">The art of slowing down</span>A little more time for living.</h2><ul class="experience-list"><li><span>01</span><h3>Walk the coastline</h3><p>Follow the paths where the land meets the sea.</p></li><li><span>02</span><h3>Dine in, linger longer</h3><p>Gather around a table as the evening unfolds.</p></li><li><span>03</span><h3>Take to the water</h3><p>Find your own rhythm in a quiet morning swim.</p></li><li><span>04</span><h3>Return to yourself</h3><p>Make space for rest, movement, and a deeper breath.</p></li></ul></div><img class="experience-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" loading="lazy" alt="Soft linen and warm light in a coastal bedroom"></div>
    </section>

    <section class="section journal" id="journal">
      <div class="container journal-grid"><img class="journal-image" id="journal-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1983" height="793" loading="lazy" alt="A rugged coastline and still sea at sunset"><div class="journal-content"><h2 class="section-title"><span class="section-label">Notes from the coast</span><span id="journal-title">Where the land gives way to sea.</span></h2><p class="section-copy" id="journal-copy">The most memorable places have a way of changing how time feels. Follow the coast, take the longer path, and see where the day leads.</p><a class="inline-link" href="#inquiry">Begin your own story <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><div class="journal-controls" aria-label="Journal stories"><button class="journal-control" type="button" data-story="0" aria-label="Story 1" aria-pressed="true" disabled>01</button><button class="journal-control" type="button" data-story="1" aria-label="Story 2" aria-pressed="false" disabled>02</button><button class="journal-control" type="button" data-story="2" aria-label="Story 3" aria-pressed="false" disabled>03</button></div></div></div>
    </section>

    <section class="statement"><div class="container"><p>Leave room for the unplanned.<br>That’s where the days become yours.</p><small>A slower way of being</small></div></section>

    <section class="section inquiry" id="inquiry">
      <div class="container inquiry-grid"><div><h2 class="section-title inquiry-heading"><span class="section-label">Your time away</span>Let the quiet begin.</h2><p class="inquiry-note">Tell us what your ideal escape looks like. This fictional template creates a private preview only; it does not send an inquiry or check availability.</p></div>
        <form class="inquiry-form" id="inquiry-form" novalidate>
          <div class="form-field full"><label for="destination">Sanctuary</label><select id="destination" name="destination" required><option value="">Choose a sanctuary</option><option>Casa Mare</option><option>Casa Oliva</option><option>Casa Sera</option><option>Help me choose</option></select></div>
          <div class="form-field"><label for="arrival">Arrival</label><input id="arrival" name="arrival" type="date" required></div><div class="form-field"><label for="departure">Departure</label><input id="departure" name="departure" type="date" required></div>
          <div class="form-field"><label for="guests">Guests</label><select id="guests" name="guests" required><option value="">Select guests</option><option value="1">1 guest</option><option value="2">2 guests</option><option value="3">3 guests</option><option value="4">4 guests</option><option value="5">5 guests</option><option value="6">6 guests</option></select></div><div class="form-field"><label for="name">Your name</label><input id="name" name="name" autocomplete="name" maxlength="100" required></div>
          <div class="form-field full"><label for="email">Email address</label><input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" maxlength="254" required></div><div class="form-field full"><label for="message">A little about your stay <span>(optional)</span></label><textarea id="message" name="message" rows="2" maxlength="2000"></textarea></div>
          <button class="primary-button" type="submit" disabled>Preview your inquiry <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button><p class="form-status" id="form-status" aria-live="polite"></p><div class="preview" id="inquiry-preview" hidden><strong>Your inquiry preview</strong><p id="preview-stay"></p><p id="preview-contact"></p><p id="preview-message"></p><p>Nothing has been sent. This demonstration is not connected to a booking service.</p></div>
          <noscript><p class="form-status">Enable JavaScript to preview an inquiry. No information will be sent.</p></noscript>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="final-cta"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1983" height="793" loading="lazy" alt="The sun setting over a quiet coastline"><div class="container"><h2 class="section-title">Return to what matters.</h2><a class="inline-link" href="#retreats">Explore the sanctuaries <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></section>
  </main>
  <footer class="footer"><div class="container"><div class="footer-grid"><div><a class="wordmark" href="#top">STILLWATER</a><p class="footer-line">Somewhere between the sea and stillness.</p></div><nav class="footer-nav" aria-label="Footer navigation"><a href="#retreats">Retreats</a><a href="#experiences">Experiences</a><a href="#philosophy">Philosophy</a><a href="#journal">Journal</a><a href="#inquiry">Inquire</a><a href="#top">Back to top</a></nav></div><div class="footer-bottom"><span>Stillwater is a fictional hospitality concept.</span><span>Imagery generated for this design.</span><span>Made for a slower kind of day.</span></div></div></footer>

  <dialog id="retreat-dialog" aria-labelledby="dialog-title"><div class="dialog-grid"><img class="dialog-image" id="dialog-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1122" height="1402" alt="A coastal terrace"><div class="dialog-content"><button class="dialog-close" type="button" aria-label="Close retreat details">×</button><h2 id="dialog-title">Casa Mare</h2><p class="section-label" id="dialog-type">Cliffside sanctuary</p><p id="dialog-description">A quiet house above the water, made for long, unhurried days.</p><p id="dialog-guests">Concept for 2 to 4 guests</p><p>Part of a fictional collection. Details are shown as an example only.</p><button class="primary-button" id="dialog-inquire" type="button">Plan an inquiry <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div></div></dialog>

  <script>
  (() => {
    const $ = (selector, root = document) => root.querySelector(selector);
    const $$ = (selector, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll(selector)];
    const menuButton = $('.menu-toggle');
    const menu = $('#mobile-menu');
    menuButton.disabled = false;
    function closeMenu() { menu.hidden = true; menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu'); }
    menuButton.addEventListener('click', () => { const opening = menu.hidden; menu.hidden = !opening; menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(opening)); menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', opening ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'); });
    menu.addEventListener('click', (event) => { if (event.target.closest('a')) closeMenu(); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape' && !menu.hidden) { closeMenu(); menuButton.focus(); } });

    const quickForm = $('#quick-booking');
    const inquiryForm = $('#inquiry-form');
    const bookingMessage = $('#booking-message');
    quickForm.querySelector('button').disabled = false;
    inquiryForm.querySelector('button').disabled = false;
    quickForm.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const arrival = $('#quick-arrival').value;
      const departure = $('#quick-departure').value;
      if ((arrival || departure) && (!arrival || !departure || departure <= arrival)) { bookingMessage.textContent = 'Choose an arrival and a later departure.'; return; }
      bookingMessage.textContent = '';
      $('#destination').value = $('#quick-destination').value || 'Help me choose';
      $('#arrival').value = arrival;
      $('#departure').value = departure;
      $('#guests').value = $('#quick-guests').value;
      $('#inquiry').scrollIntoView({ behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
      $('#destination').focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
    inquiryForm.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const status = $('#form-status');
      const preview = $('#inquiry-preview');
      preview.hidden = true;
      $$('input, select', inquiryForm).forEach((field) => field.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'));
      const required = $$('[required]', inquiryForm);
      const invalid = required.find((field) => !field.checkValidity());
      if (invalid) { invalid.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); status.textContent = invalid.type === 'email' ? 'Enter a valid email address.' : 'Complete the required fields to preview your inquiry.'; invalid.focus(); return; }
      if (!$('#name').value.trim()) { $('#name').setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); status.textContent = 'Enter your name to preview your inquiry.'; $('#name').focus(); return; }
      if ($('#departure').value <= $('#arrival').value) { $('#departure').setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); status.textContent = 'Departure must be after arrival.'; $('#departure').focus(); return; }
      const dateLabel = (value) => { const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number); return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en', { day:'numeric', month:'long', year:'numeric' }).format(new Date(year, month - 1, day)); };
      $('#preview-stay').textContent = `${$('#destination').value}, ${dateLabel($('#arrival').value)} to ${dateLabel($('#departure').value)}, ${$('#guests').selectedOptions[0].textContent}`;
      $('#preview-contact').textContent = `${$('#name').value.trim()}, ${$('#email').value.trim()}`;
      $('#preview-message').textContent = $('#message').value.trim() ? `Note: ${$('#message').value.trim()}` : '';
      status.textContent = 'Preview ready. No inquiry has been sent.';
      preview.hidden = false;
    });

    const retreats = {
      mare: { name:'Casa Mare', type:'Cliffside sanctuary', guests:'Concept for 2 to 4 guests', image:'#image-terrace', description:'A quiet house above the water, made for long, unhurried days.' },
      oliva: { name:'Casa Oliva', type:'Olive grove house', guests:'Concept for 2 to 6 guests', image:'#image-lounge', description:'A light-filled retreat framed by olive trees, stone, and sea.' },
      sera: { name:'Casa Sera', type:'Secluded hideaway', guests:'Concept for 2 to 4 guests', image:'#image-bedroom', description:'A restful hideaway for slow mornings and golden evenings.' }
    };
    const dialog = $('#retreat-dialog');
    let selectedRetreat = 'Casa Mare';
    let lastTrigger = null;
    $$('[data-retreat]').forEach((button) => { button.disabled = false; button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const item = retreats[button.dataset.retreat]; lastTrigger = button; selectedRetreat = item.name;
      $('#dialog-title').textContent = item.name; $('#dialog-type').textContent = item.type; $('#dialog-guests').textContent = item.guests; $('#dialog-description').textContent = item.description;
      $('#dialog-image').src = $(item.image).src; $('#dialog-image').alt = $(item.image).alt;
      dialog.showModal();
    }); });
    $('.dialog-close').addEventListener('click', () => dialog.close());
    dialog.addEventListener('close', () => { if (lastTrigger) lastTrigger.focus(); });
    $('#dialog-inquire').addEventListener('click', () => { lastTrigger = null; dialog.close(); $('#destination').value = selectedRetreat; $('#inquiry').scrollIntoView({ behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }); $('#destination').focus({ preventScroll:true }); });

    const features = {
      privacy:{ image:'#image-terrace', title:'Entirely your own.', copy:'A secluded setting gives you the freedom to follow the day at your own pace.' },
      architecture:{ image:'#image-lounge', title:'Made to belong.', copy:'Limestone, timber, and glass draw the landscape into every room.' },
      nature:{ image:'#image-bedroom', title:'Close to the elements.', copy:'Wake to changing light, salt air, and the quiet presence of the sea.' }
    };
    $$('[data-feature]').forEach((button) => { button.disabled = false; button.addEventListener('click', () => { const item = features[button.dataset.feature]; $$('[data-feature]').forEach((tab) => tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(tab === button))); $('#feature-image').src = $(item.image).src; $('#feature-image').alt = $(item.image).alt; $('#feature-title').textContent = item.title; $('#feature-copy').textContent = item.copy; }); });

    const stories = [
      { image:'#journal-image', title:'Where the land gives way to sea.', copy:'The most memorable places have a way of changing how time feels. Follow the coast, take the longer path, and see where the day leads.' },
      { image:'#image-terrace', title:'The beauty of an unhurried morning.', copy:'Open the doors, pour something warm, and let the morning arrive without an agenda.' },
      { image:'#image-lounge', title:'A quieter kind of gathering.', copy:'The best moments are often the simplest: a shared table, a familiar voice, and nowhere else to be.' }
    ];
    const coastImage = $('#journal-image').src;
    const coastAlt = $('#journal-image').alt;
    $$('[data-story]').forEach((button) => { button.disabled = false; button.addEventListener('click', () => { const index = Number(button.dataset.story); const story = stories[index]; $$('[data-story]').forEach((control) => control.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(control === button))); $('#journal-image').src = index === 0 ? coastImage : $(story.image).src; $('#journal-image').alt = index === 0 ? coastAlt : $(story.image).alt; $('#journal-title').textContent = story.title; $('#journal-copy').textContent = story.copy; }); });
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => entries.forEach((entry) => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('is-in'); observer.unobserve(entry.target); } }), { threshold:.18 });
      $$('.section').forEach((section) => observer.observe(section));
    }
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
]]>
    </file>
  </files>
</template>
